name: Loading

props.name: active
props.description: Specify whether you want the loading indicator to be spinning or not

props.name: description
props.description: Specify a description that would be used to best describe the loading state

props.name: small
props.description: Specify whether you would like the small variant of <Loading>

props.name: withOverlay
props.description: Specify whether you want the loader to be applied with an overlay

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Loading rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
